stories.headline: Is Ethiopia on the verge of another civil war as fighting erupts in Tigray?
stories.description: Seven armed groups have joined forces against Abiy Ahmed’s government, bringing former enemies into the same alliance.

stories.headline: Huge crowds greet Pope in Paris ahead of open-air Mass
stories.description: More than half a million people are expected to attend the event in the heart of the French capital.

stories.headline: How long can Labour's feel-good factor last?
stories.description: Labour's spirits are up since Burnham became PM, but Laura Kuenssberg asks what lies ahead.

stories.headline: Athens explosion: Six dead in blast near Acropolis in Plaka district
stories.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

stories.headline: Turkiye calls for UN Security Council veto to end: Could it happen?
stories.description: Fully abolishing the veto would require the unlikely agreement of all five permanent Security Council members.
